facts.fact: Sierraloaded reports that at the 18 June 2024 WAPIS steering committee the government's Chief of Staff at the Office of National Security acknowledged the European Union's critical funding of the programme and urged an exit strategy and budget planning for after 2025.
Sierraloaded reports that INTERPOL implements the West Africa Police Information System programme in Sierra Leone Police.

systems.system: West Africa Police Information System (WAPIS) / I-24/7

SLE.note: The 100 workstations are announced, not delivered, and the source does not say stations record reports in the system.
